scope: Length bounds allow a full cap turn as a mathematical envelope; moment arms sample it. Rigid screening varies one swivel at a time from neutral along the shortest arc toward minimum length, with elbow fixed at 0/10/20/30 deg and the other swivel neutral. Only pairs affected by that swivel are checked, including the existing stop geometry. No forces or TPU contact.
